rationale: Y directly engages the core reviewer debate (gcanlin's exact objection that cudagraph_mode shouldn't leak into modeling code, and the follow-up ask to make the runner own the decision) and pushes it further with a concrete fix, while also connecting the NPU talker_mtp_graph_safe flag to the real-world Wallbreazzz crash and flagging the unexplained capacity retune that Sy0307/amy-why-3459 asked to justify. X spends most of its comment budget re-confirming already-resolved concerns (marked '[resolved]'/'[claim-verified]') and flagging documentation staleness that no human reviewer raised, so despite similar surface thoroughness and decent grounding, it covers much less of what the actual reviewers cared about and offers shallower fixes for the seed-reproducibility and NPU-safety threads.
